title: creatures
description: A corpus's creature catalog: every creature the client knows, what kind it is, and which model and preset draws each of its looks. Where a creature lives is server data, so the catalog places nothing.

$schema.description: The schema this document follows, by its `$id`: the last path segment names the file in husk's schema/ directory, and schema_version says which version of it (REFACTOR/BUNDLE_FORMAT.md "The contract header").

schema_version.description: Version of the schema this document conforms to.

subject.description: The catalog; it has no identity of its own.

space.description: Units and axes of every value in the document.

definition.description: A catalog defines nothing beyond its entries.

references.description: The model documents the displays draw, each once, ascending by file id. Displays name them by id: the list runs to thousands, so a position would shift with every re-export.

id.description: This reference's stable id, derived from the model's file id.

asset.description: The model file, named from the listfile when the exporter had one; uri when its document is in the tree.

creatures.description: Every creature the client's table lists. The client ships only part of the game's creatures.

id.description: This creature's stable id, unique among the catalog's creatures.

name.description: Display name; absent when the source names none.

name_source.description: Where the name came from. Present exactly when name is.

title.description: The line shown under the name, e.g. a profession; absent when there is none.

type.description: What kind of being it is (Beast, Dragonkin, Humanoid, ...): the source's type row, with its name. Absent when the source gives none.

family.description: Its family within the type (Wolf, Boar, Carrion Bird, ...): the source's family row, with its name. Absent when the source gives none.

classification.description: The source's rank of the creature, as stored. No client table names the values; community documentation reads 0 normal, 1 elite, 2 rare elite, 3 boss, 4 rare, 5 trivial, 6 minus, not checked here.

displays.description: The looks the creature is drawn with, one per source display slot in slot order; a look may repeat.

weight.description: The source's weight for this look among the creature's looks, as stored. Unused slots and a creature's only look can carry any value, 0 included; how the client picks a look from the weights is not established.

id.description: The source's own record of the creature.

displays.description: Every look a creature names: the model that draws it and the preset of that model it is.

id.description: This display's stable id, unique among the catalog's displays.

model.description: The id of the model reference that draws it. Absent when the source names no model for it.

preset.description: Index into the model document's selection.presets: the preset listing this display among its sources. Absent when the model document is not exported or lists no such preset.

scale.description: The display's own scale; the same value as the preset source's scale in the model document.

base_scale.description: The model data row's scale; the same value as the preset source's base_scale in the model document.

id.description: The source's own record of the display.
